question: Which of the following is a computer application software?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Word Processor.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A word processor (WP) is a **computer program or application software** that provides for input, editing, formatting, and output of text, often with some additional features.
 
• An application program or software is a computer program designed to carry out a specific task other than one relating to the operation of the computer itself. 
 
• Some examples of application software are **media players, accounting software, spreadsheet software**, etc. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Java **- Java is a popular programming language. Java is used to develop mobile apps, web apps, desktop apps, games, and much more. 
 
• **Visual Basic **- It is an object-oriented programming language developed and owned by Microsoft. It is used to create macros to automate repetitive word- and data-processing functions, and generate custom forms, graphs, and reports.
 
• **RAM **- Random Access Memory (RAM) is a general-purpose memory that usually stores the user data in a program. RAM is volatile, which means it cannot retain data in the absence of power.
